note: Ace Editor integrates the external Ace ('ace-builds') JS code editor through three core extension points and defines no plugin types of its own: an 'ace_editor' text-editor plugin (attached per text format via an editor.editor.<format> config entity, meaningful settings nested under settings.fieldset.*), an 'ace_formatter' field formatter for text_long/text_with_summary, and an 'ace_filter' text filter for <ace>...</ace> tags. Global defaults live in the config object ace_editor.settings (theme/syntax/height/width/font_size/line_numbers/show_invisibles/print_margins/auto_complete/use_wrap_mode plus theme_list/syntax_list); there is NO admin settings form and NO configure route, so defaults are changed with drush config:set. The Ace JS library is not bundled and must be placed under /libraries/ace. The shipped ace_editor.permission.yml is mis-named (core reads *.permissions.yml) so 'administer ace_editor' is not registered. Medium/hard cases are grounded in real config: introspection reads which format uses the Ace editor (settings.fieldset.theme) and which format has ace_filter (filters.ace_filter.settings.syntax); execution attaches the ace_editor editor plugin to a format and enables the ace_filter, verified against live editor.editor / filter.format config.

evals.prompt: The Drupal ace_editor module has no admin settings page, yet it ships site-wide default values for the code editor (theme, syntax, height, font size, etc.). What config object holds those defaults, and since there is no UI, how would you change one such as the default theme?
evals.expected_output: The defaults live in the config object ace_editor.settings (keys theme, syntax, height, width, font_size, line_numbers, show_invisibles, print_margins, auto_complete, use_wrap_mode, plus the theme_list/syntax_list option maps). There is no settings form or configure route, so you change a default with drush config:set ace_editor.settings theme monokai -y (or via config import).

evals.prompt: How do you make a Drupal text format use the Ace code editor (from the ace_editor module) as its editing widget? Name the editor plugin id and the config entity involved.
evals.expected_output: Assign the 'ace_editor' text-editor plugin to the format. In the UI: Configuration > Content authoring > Text formats and editors, edit a format, set Text editor = Ace Editor. As config it is an editor.editor.<format> entity with editor: ace_editor and the Ace settings nested under settings.fieldset.* (theme, syntax, height, width, font_size, line_numbers, print_margins, show_invisibles, use_wrap_mode, auto_complete).

evals.prompt: Using the ace_editor module, how can an author drop a syntax-highlighted code snippet directly into body text? Which text filter and which markup tag does that, and how do you highlight it as a specific language?
evals.expected_output: Enable the Ace Filter (id ace_filter) on the text format, then wrap code in <ace>...</ace> tags. Per-tag attributes override the filter defaults, so <ace syntax="php" theme="monokai">...</ace> highlights that block as PHP with the Monokai theme. The filter replaces each block with a <pre> that the Ace JS turns into a highlighted view.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site one text format has been set up to use the Ace code editor. Inspect the live configuration and tell me the machine name of that text format and which Ace color theme its editor is configured to use.
evals.expected_output: The format is ace_editor_m1: its editor.editor.ace_editor_m1 config entity has editor: ace_editor with settings.fieldset.theme: monokai (and syntax: php).

evals.prompt: A text format on this site has the ace_editor module's Ace Filter enabled. Inspect the live filter configuration and report which text format it is and what language (syntax) the filter highlights by default.
evals.expected_output: Format ace_editor_m2 has the ace_filter enabled (filters.ace_filter.status: true) with settings.syntax: python, so <ace> blocks default to Python highlighting.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is a text format with machine name ace_editor_h1 that currently has no text editor attached. Using the ace_editor module, configure this format to use the Ace code editor with the 'twilight' theme and 'javascript' syntax, and apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Create/save an editor.editor.ace_editor_h1 config entity with editor: ace_editor and settings.fieldset.theme: twilight, settings.fieldset.syntax: javascript (e.g. via Editor::create([...])->save() or the Text formats and editors UI).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is a text format with machine name ace_editor_h2. Using the ace_editor module, enable its Ace Filter (ace_filter) and set the filter to highlight Ruby (syntax = ruby) by default, then apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In filter.format.ace_editor_h2 enable the ace_filter (filters.ace_filter.status: true) with settings.syntax: ruby (e.g. $format->setFilterConfig('ace_filter', ['status' => 1, 'settings' => ['syntax' => 'ruby']])->save()).
